questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

His poems are __recondite__ in subject matter
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**simple**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the** meaning **of the given word.

 
 
• **recondite**: 

 (of a subject or knowledge) little-known; abstruse.

 
 
• 
 **Example**: *The Professor of sociology said, " The area of your research deals with economics and finance which are **recondite **__to me."*
 
 
 
 
 
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the **given options**.
 __
 
• **brief: **of short duration; not lasting for long.
 
• **simple: **
 easily understood or done; presenting no difficulty.
 
 
• **mystical: **
 having a spiritual symbolic or allegorical significance that transcends human understanding.
 
 
• **obscure: **
 not discovered or known about; uncertain.
 
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**simple**" is the antonym of the word "**recondite**".
 
 
• **Example**: *The couple decided to have a **simple **__wedding with a limited number of guests.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word**

Comely
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Grotesque**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Comely** means pleasurably conforming to notions of good appearance, suitability, or proportion.

 ***• Example- ******She is very comely, with the beauty indigenous to this country.***

 
• Marked option **Grotesque** means a very ugly or comically distorted figure or image.

 ***• Example- ****It was something **grotesque**, but definitely not a skeleton.*

 
• It is clear that Comely and Grotesque are **opposite in meaning**.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grandiloquent** means speaking or expressed in a lofty style, often to the point of being pompous or bombastic.
 
• **Gorgeous** means splendidly or showily brilliant or magnificent.
 
• **Gregarious **means fond of the company of others; sociable.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Her actions reveal that she is still __nimble__ and alert in her responses.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**Tardy"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nimble** means quick and light in movement or action. It can be used to describe a person who is able to move quickly and easily, or it can be used to describe something that is able to move or be handled easily.__ (फुर्तीला का अर्थ है गति या क्रिया में तेज। इसका उपयोग किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति का वर्णन करने के लिए किया जा सकता है जो जल्दी और आसानी से आगे बढ़ने में सक्षम है, या इसका उपयोग किसी ऐसी चीज का वर्णन करने के लिए किया जा सकता है जो आसानी से चलने या संभालने में सक्षम हो।)

 __
 
• **Example: **The nimble thief was able to slip through the crowds unnoticed and escape with the jewels.
 
 

**Let's see the meanings of the given words:**__

__
 
• **Agile-** It means being quick and flexible in movement or action. (इसका अर्थ है गति या क्रिया में तेज और लचीला होना।)

 
 
• **Example:** *The **agile** cat was able to quickly evade the dog's attack by leaping up onto a tree branch.*
 
 
 
• **Deft-** It means being skilled or adept at doing something, often something requiring a delicate touch or precise movement. (इसका अर्थ है कुछ करने में कुशल या निपुण होना, अक्सर ऐसा कुछ जिसके लिए नाजुक स्पर्श या सटीक गति की आवश्यकता होती है।)
 
 
• **Example: ***The thief was able to **deftly** pick the lock and escape with the jewels.*
 
 
 
• **Swift- **It means being quick or fast. (इसका अर्थ है तेज होना।)
 
 
• **Example: ***The **swift** response of the emergency services prevented the fire from spreading and saved the building from destruction.*
 
 
 
• **Tardy****- **It means being late or behind schedule. (इसका अर्थ है देर से या समय से पीछे होना।)
 
 
• **Example:** *The **tardy **delivery of the package caused delays in the production schedule.*
 
 

According to the meanings of the given words, *the correct answer is **Option 4, i.e., tardy.***

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Giving a __laconic__ she left the room in a hurry.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**longwinded"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Laconic **means using very few words, especially when speaking or writing. It can also refer to someone who is terse or succinct in their communication.__ (लैकोनिक का अर्थ है बहुत कम शब्दों का प्रयोग करना, विशेष रूप से बोलते या लिखते समय। यह किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति को भी संदर्भित कर सकता है जो अपने संचार में संक्षिप्त या संक्षिप्त है।)

 __
 
• **Example:** He was known for his laconic responses, often answering questions with just a few words.
 
 

**Let's see the meanings of the given words:__**

__
 
• **Longwinded- **taking a long time to say something or being verbose, or wordy. (इसका अर्थ है कुछ कहने या शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण होने या शब्दों में बोलने में लंबा समय लेना।)

 
 
• **Example: **"*The professor's lectures were always **longwinded**, and it was hard for the students to stay focused for the entire class." *
 
 
 
• **Offhand-** done or said without much thought or preparation. (इसका अर्थ है बिना ज्यादा सोचे समझे या तैयारी के किया या कहा गया।)
 
 
• **Example:** *He made an **offhand** remark about the weather, not realizing it would offend his friend who had just moved from a hot climate.*
 
 
 
• **Informal-** not formal or ceremonious. (इसका अर्थ है औपचारिक नहीं।)
 
 
• **Example:** *The party was supposed to be an **informal** gathering, but some guests showed up in formal attire, making them feel out of place. *
 
 
 
• **Brief-** It means short or concise. (इसका अर्थ है संक्षिप्त)
 
 
• **Example: ***The lawyer gave a **brief** overview of the case before going into more detail in the courtroom." *
 
 

According to the meanings of the given words, *the correct answer is **Option 1, i.e., longwinded.***

questions.question:

She has a __penchant__ for art and craft.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. '**hatred**.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given word and **marked option**:

 
 
• Penchant- a liking for or a habit of doing something, especially something that other people might not like. (कुछ करने की आदत या पसंद, विशेष रूप से ऐसा कुछ जो अन्य लोगों को पसंद न हो।)
 
• Hatred- an extremely strong feeling of dislike. (नापसंदगी की एक बेहद मजबूत भावना।)
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other **given options**:
 
 
• **Fear- **to be worried or frightened that something bad might happen or might have happened. (चिंतित या भयभीत होना कि कुछ बुरा हो सकता है या हो सकता है।)
 
• **Joy- **great happiness. (महान खुशी।)
 
• **Anxiety- **an uncomfortable feeling of nervousness or worry about something that is happening or might happen in the future. (घबराहट की एक असहज भावना या जो कुछ हो रहा है या भविष्य में हो सकता है उसके बारे में चिंता करना।)
 
 
 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that ‘penchant’ and ‘hatred’ are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 1.

After ten hours of fruitless negotiations, he stormed out of the meeting in __**exasperation**__.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'​Delight'.****
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word and the correct answer.
 
• **Exasperation:** the feeling of being annoyed, especially because you can do nothing to solve a problem (नाराज़ होने की भावना, खासकर क्योंकि आप किसी समस्या को हल करने के लिए कुछ नहीं कर सकते हैं; खीज)
 
 
• *​Example: There is growing **exasperation** within the government at the failure of these policies to reduce unemployment.*
 
 
 
• Delight: great pleasure. (परम आनन्द)
 
 
• *Example: The little girls squealed with **delight**.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the word ​**'**Delight' is the most appropriate antonym for **Exasperation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's explore the **meaning **of other options

 
 
• **Resentment****: **bitter indignation at having been treated unfairly. (क्रोध) 
 
• **Disgust****: **a feeling of revulsion or strong disapproval aroused by something unpleasant or offensive. (घृणा)
 
• **Wrath****: **extreme anger. (क्रोध)
